Resolves #22024

In three-column Examples groups, a lone final demonstration now spans the row with its existing cover beside its title, description and links. Workers & Platform, Lists & Galleries and Multi-Window all reach the right edge while preserving the lead card's existing dimensions.

Evidence: L3 (compiled Portal in headless Chromium with real catalog geometry, keyboard interaction and rendered covers) → L3 required (AC-1 through AC-4).

CI jobs: +0.

## AC Evidence

| Criterion | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | Outside CI, measured full row coverage at 1366 and 1440 px with 4, 7 and 10 demonstration cards. Workers & Platform switches from two columns at 1363 px to a full final row at 1364 px. Covers stay at 16:9, and the first card retains its measured bounds on both sides of the existing lead-card breakpoint. |
| AC-2 | Outside CI, ArrowDown moved selection and DOM focus onto the Workers & Platform final card. The details and launch cue became visible, and the cue matched the title link destination. |
| AC-3 | Outside CI, Lists & Galleries retained its two-column layout at 1280 px and single-column layout at 390 px. The complete 21-card Grid & Table layout already filled its final row. The local Portal catalog suite covered Forms & Fields tiles and navigation. |
| AC-4 | The full-tab Workers & Platform pairs below show both states at 1440 × 1110 and 1366 × 1080 with loaded covers. |

## Deltas from ticket

The final-row rule follows the named group-page container that sets the three-column grid.

## Test Evidence

Five focused tests in [ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/bd9ca823e4fea98e4e0a121471cd593e4e0e525c/test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs) passed locally, alongside direct browser checks of the actual examples groups. The stylesheet commit also passed the theme coverage and reference checks.

Frame critique: The short caption and launch controls leave a wide gap on the new card. The full-width layout preserves the lead framing, keeps the full cover visible, and aligns the last card with the grid edges.

## Cold look

| Order shown | Before | After |

| Before, after | 7/10 | 8/10 |
| After, before | 6/10 | 8/10 |

Both preferred the filled row. The empty space between the short description and right-aligned links was the main trade-off they noted.
